item.title: Paramount+ and HBO Max to merge into one streaming service after WBD deal closes
item.description: Ellison reassured investors that HBO’s identity and creative vision as a studio would remain unchanged, stating, “Our viewpoint is HBO should stay HBO.”

item.title: Users are ditching ChatGPT for Claude — here’s how to make the switch
item.description: Following controversies surrounding ChatGPT, many users are ditching the AI chatbot for Claude instead. Here's how to make the switch.

item.title: Instagram tracked growing usage while targeting teens, lawyers argue
item.description: The company said usage grew from 40 minutes per day in 2023 to 46 minutes in 2026. Other documents referenced teens as being a top priority for the app before asking existing users for birthdays.

item.title: A new app alerts you if someone nearby is wearing smart glasses
item.description: A hobbyist developer's new app, which can detect nearby smart glasses, comes amid resistance to always-on recording and listening devices that invade people's privacy.

item.title: No one has a good plan for how AI companies should work with the government
item.description: As OpenAI transitions from a wildly successful consumer startup into a piece of national security infrastructure, the company seems unequipped to manage its new responsibilities.

item.title: Geopolitical drama reportedly stalls IPO of SoftBank-backed PayPay
item.description: The Japan-based company reportedly aimed for a public valuation of at least ¥1.5 trillion ($10 billion).

item.title: Stripe wants to turn your AI costs into a profit center
item.description: Stripe released a preview intended to allow AI companies to easily track, pass through, and make a profit on underlying AI model fees.

item.title: ChatGPT uninstalls surged by 295% after DoD deal
item.description: Many consumers ditched ChatGPT's app after news of its DoD deal went live, while Claude's downloads grew.

item.title: India’s Pronto formalizes house help as its valuation jumps 8x in under a year
item.description: Pronto handles 18,000 daily bookings and plans rapid expansion as it races rivals to digitize India's largely offline home services market.

item.title: Cursor has reportedly surpassed $2B in annualized revenue
item.description: The four-year-old startup saw its revenue run rate double over the past three months, according to one Bloomberg source.
